scope: All records in the eight precommitted heldout source tiles; exact source-preserving subset input pins.
split_rationale: Development reuses the nine-tile raw pilot and known connector regions. Holdout tiles are frozen from source-only geographic controls, a dateline tile, and the densest source tile. Rectangular geographic controls are not claims of continental membership.

overview.meaning: Cells touched by original width-observation geometry; display coverage, not riverbank polygons or measured width. No invented connections or individual-feature lookup at overview zooms.
overview.boundaries: Closed-cell intersection in continuous spherical Web Mercator, without native Tippecanoe rounding. X cells wrap periodically modulo grid size, including both edge columns for a segment exactly on the antimeridian. Clamp only the finite north/south world edge. Unwrap crossing segments to their shortest periodic frame; never connect separate source parts.
overview.aggregation: 2 by 2 logical OR from the finest occupancy grid.
overview.encoding: Nonoverlapping horizontal cell-run rectangles as separate valid MVT polygons.
gates: Every decoded overview cell exactly matches the source-derived occupancy mask at every zoom.
Independent segment/cell-intersection oracle on frozen heldout source records and boundary fixtures.
Zero invalid polygons, non-grid vertices, overlaps or unexpected layers.
Global overview has nonempty data at every zoom 0 through 7.
overview.projection: x=(longitude+180)/360*N; y=(1-asinh(tan(latitude*pi/180))/pi)/2*N; latitude clipped to +/-85.0511287798066 only for display. Source coordinates remain unchanged.

gates: All original detail tile coordinates, feature multiplicity, IDs, integer geometry commands and retained attribute values match the sealed r1 archive. No geometry rescale.
No new omissions; the same 304 source observations remain absent from z12 due to documented native quantization collapse. All remain in GeoParquet.

size.miss_policy: Preserve the failed benchmark. Review a new explicit design or threshold revision before evaluating further candidates; do not silently relax fidelity.

browser.exact_id_lookup: Read complete source attributes by unique feature_id; establish row-group pruning from ID statistics and actual range requests.
browser.timing: Report measurements; no latency pass threshold on this shared Mac.

resources.bulk_policy: Reference existing bulk files; no new copies of the source or analytical release. Preserve failed evidence; cleanup only within existing authorization.

reproducibility: Commit criteria and source split before running candidate benchmarks.
Focused refusal/fixture tests, clean-checkout regional replay, content-bound manifests and reports.
New display release raw-v01.01-display-r2 only after validation; never overwrite r1.
